versions.changelog:
## Fruitful Orchards 1.0

First release.

- Fruit trees can grow two fruits on a day instead of one: cherry, apricot, orange, peach, pomegranate, apple, banana and mango.
- Choose the chance of the second fruit in the config: 25 %, 50 % (default) or 100 %.
- Growth time stays at 28 days. Seasons, fruit quality and the trees' look stay as they are.

## Fruitful Orchards 1.1

The settings are now in German too.

- The chance setting for the second fruit now has a readable name, description and value labels in the in-game config menu, in English and German. Players with the game set to German see it in German; everyone else keeps English.
- Same trees, same chances, same default, nothing else changes. Your setting carries over.
